js: 'Keys & budgets as a list beside the selected key (modern design WP11): the status page with nothing selected (the global budget, the New key form, pairing, the link strip, the transfers), the rows under their kind\'s heading, a click selecting a key (its path, the hero, the Spend group and the policy groups), the arrows moving the selection, a deep link selecting its row, the search (/ focuses, Esc clears, a second Esc back to the list), the Usage views switch under the title, a device\'s detail (its Connection group and its admin-tools dropdown), the policy as rows: a note typed (the accent dot, the save toast), the guard asking when another row is picked, Ctrl+S saving, the saved note read back after a reload, Ctrl+S with nothing changed sending nothing, a past expiry asking before it is saved and again for another past moment, then Revoke from its danger row (its question, done, back to the status page), a new key\'s page showing its plaintext and Loading… while the list is read again, a row picked while a create is out (the plaintext still reaches the new key\'s page), and the narrow window (one pane at a time, the back button). It CREATES and REVOKES client keys named wp11-drive, wp11-fresh and wp11-left and saves the first one\'s note: a dev copy only, never production. Run: scripts/ui-drive.py scripts/drive/keys-split.json --dsf 1.25 --token-file <dir>.token --base http://<addr>'

(async()=>{const j=async(u,b)=>(await fetch(u,{method:b===undefined?'GET':'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},body:b===undefined?undefined:JSON.stringify(b)})).json();const r=await j('/api/usage/keys');for(const k of (r.keys||[]))if(k.name==='wp11-drive')await j('/api/op/key_delete',{id:k.id});const c=await j('/api/op/key_create',{name:'wp11-drive',kind:'client'});sessionStorage.setItem('wp11.id',String(c.id));localStorage.removeItem('lmgw.ui.keys.list.width');return 'created '+c.id})()

js: (async()=>{const j=async(u,b)=>(await fetch(u,{method:b===undefined?'GET':'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},body:b===undefined?undefined:JSON.stringify(b)})).json();const r=await j('/api/usage/keys');let n=0;for(const k of (r.keys||[]))if(k.name==='wp11-left'||k.name==='wp11-fresh'){await j('/api/op/key_delete',{id:k.id});n++}return 'deleted '+n})()

window.__slow = {}; const f0 = window.fetch; window.fetch = (u, o) => { const url = String((u && u.url) || u); const m = ((o && o.method) || (u && u.method) || 'GET').toUpperCase(); const p = f0(u, o); for (const [k, until] of Object.entries(window.__slow)) { const [mm, path] = k.split(' '); if (m === mm && url.includes(path) && Date.now() < until) return p.then(r => new Promise(res => setTimeout(() => res(r), until - Date.now()))); } return p; }; window.__made = []; 'slow fetch'
